text:
Hello dear friends,
I would appreciate your advice regarding the partner visa process in Israel.

I have a Swedish partner whom I met in Thailand. After our trip together, I flew to Sweden and stayed with her for about a month and a half in the apartment she rents. After that, she came to Israel and stayed with me at my parents’ home for about ten days.

At the moment, she is in Sweden and I am in Israel. We would like to start the process of regulating her status in Israel so that she can come and live with me here.

If it’s relevant, we are both 23 years old, and we have been together since mid-January.

In your experience, would you recommend hiring a lawyer for the process, or is it realistic to handle everything on our own? Any advice, experiences, or tips would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you very much! 😊
